source.author: verg
source.text: Descendo, ac ducente deo flammam inter et hostis expedior; dant tela locum, flammaeque recedunt.
source.text_original: Descendo, ac ducente deo flammam inter et hostis / expedior; dant tela locum, flammaeque recedunt.
source.text_english: I descend, and, with the god leading, I make my way between the fire and the enemies; the weapons give way, and the flames retreat.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text_english: through how many crises of affairs I am brought out safely.
